observation.source: Current fact_preauth.validate enforces exact external raw digest, closed fields and values; it does not enforce compact serialization for approved template bytes.
observation.taskMeaning: Fixed old hash with altered pretty JSON is rejected. Mandatory canonical template serialization has not been proven. The contract explicitly demands canonical policy bytes at CLI, whose actual path is NOT_RUN here. If the intended template contract also requires a single canonical serialization, the observed ACCEPT is a requirement/implementation gap for coordinator adjudication, not a PASS of canonical rejection.
